_ExplicitRuntimeAdapter._verify_and_jour.receipt_write: Original BoundEcommerceGrowthRuntimeStore.put must remain inside same caller

decisions: ContentCapacityOwner supplies TransactionBoundConnectFactory to AgentRun service; default capacity gate inherits that same factory. Do not claim this particular capacity gate always opens a separate physical connection.
Original ACK needs actual running AgentRun and live original reservation, but no separate committed start check. Original put requires capacity accepted row xmin equal current xid.

Candidate: same caller original running transition -> ACK -> put -> claim -> original build/revalidate -> exact trusted adapter execute/verify_and_journal -> original budget ACK -> joint finalize -> actual outer COMMIT.

LockedEcommerceGrowthHostPort.commit currently owns outer COMMIT; it cannot be called unchanged by a joint owner. Need exact trusted same-caller entry, without arbitrary bindings/callback/connection export.

Original ContentGenerateHostService uses old reserve API with a borrowed wrapper. Native joint budget method is a separate strict interface; same caller injection must reuse original algorithm without a second reserve.
